mentions.name: GeoPeek
mentions.description: A macOS Quick Look extension for GeoJSON that renders .geojson files as a map when pressing Space in Finder, instead of raw JSON, and also displays an attribute table and basic stats.
mentions.problem: Previewing a .geojson in Finder only shows raw JSON; the author, who works with geospatial data, wanted a quick map view instead.
mentions.source_excerpt: GeoPeek, a small macOS Quick Look extension for GeoJSON. I work with geospatial data and wanted to press Space on a .geojson in Finder and see a map instead of raw JSON. It also shows an attribute table and basic stats.
mentions.author: serifsadi
